{{Quote|Commander Cody, do you have the exact coordinates of the command ship yet?|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] "[[Cody/Legends|Cody]]"|<ref name="GI" />}}
A '''''Recusant''-class light destroyer''' was used by the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] at the [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|Battle near the Arda system]] and [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]] as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]].

==Description==
[[File:FirstBattleOfSaleucami-GI.png|thumb|left|200px|Grievous's command ship flanked by three ''Munificent''-class frigates]]
The [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]]<ref name="OEG:S1-2" /> surpassed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in length and could easily outmatch its firepower with some assistance from [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. It had several large [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] positioned near the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] section, which was itself based on the ''Munificent''-class' bridge tower. There was also heavy turbolaser on the prow. It could carry a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] on its ventral surface and, unlike regular ''Recusant''s, was equipped with [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]],<ref name="GI" /> one of the modifications unique to the ship.<ref name="Starships Collection 77">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 77|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 77]]</ref>

==History==
The vessel was used to board [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|kidnap]] the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], setting a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|trap]] for the Republic task force sent to save him and in turn kidnap Grievous. It exchanged fire with the Venator but neither ship was badly damaged. It was later damaged and left to drift after capturing a [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]] and targeting it at point blank range.<ref name="GI" /> When blowing up the ''Arquitens'', it was hit by debris and most of the crew including the main tactical droid was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Galli]]. Most of the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]], and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] onboard were destroyed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Eeth Koth. The rest of the crew other than a few remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were put on the landing craft going down to Salecumi. It is assumed that Anakin Skywalker destroyed the ship and most of General Grievous' fleet when saying he finished the battle in space.
